title: Dependency audit tool, warn first and enforce by setting
goal: A template tool that audits production dependencies and fails only when the project sets it to enforce
acceptance: `core/tools/dependency-audit.mjs` runs `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --json`; the setting `audit.dependencies` in `.harness.json` is `warn` (default: prints findings, exits 0), `enforce` (exits 1 on a high or critical finding) or `off`
A registry error, an offline run or unparsable output reads "unknown" and exits non-zero only under `enforce`; it is never printed as clean
Fixtures are invented `npm audit --json` payloads: none, moderate only, high, critical, malformed, registry error
Failing test committed first: each fixture above fails against an empty tool before the tool exists; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One small wrapper, a settings read and six fixtures, from the report's 1.5 h plus the failing-first fixtures. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
